tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa blang ba'i lag len bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa len par 'dod pas/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i bar/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa bzhin bsgom/ de nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug byas pas/ lus kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gsal gdab/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas shing*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs la/ dkar mo ri dwags la sogs pas mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje la sogs pas bstod/ maṇḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la zhes pa la sogs pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab pa nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi bar bdag 'jug ltar bya/ 'on kyang rig pa'i dbang lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams phyag gnyis par bsgom/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ni/ lam gyi chos mtshon par byed pa yin la/ lha rnams ni 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ yon tan mtshon par byed cing*/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dang gsung dang thugs la tshang ngo zhes pa tsam gyis de kho na nyid dran par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis phyi dang nang dang de kho na nyid kyi sgo nas phyi dang*/ nang gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod par gyis zhes mchod pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ gang zang so so'i khams dang bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces sems can gyi don gyi rjes gnang dang*/ sems can rnams la dbang po dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis shig ces chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang sbyin par bsam/

yang maṇḍal phul nas/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs la sogs pas gsol ba gdab/ gsang ba'i dbang dngos dang*/ lung bstan bdag 'jug bzhin bya/ yang maṇḍal phul la/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// la sogs pas gsol ba gdab pa nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bdag 'jug bzhin blang*/ de nas gtso bo'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis rang gi dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad la nan tan du gyis zhes pas lam dus kyi dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ sems can rnams sdug bsngal las dbugs dbyung zhes 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung gnang bar bsam/ yang maṇḍal phul la/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// la sogs pas gsol ba gdab pa nas/ dbang bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi dang*/ gzengs bstod pa'i bar bdag 'jug bzhin bya/ de nas yon du dmigs la/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa thams cad dbul ba la sogs pa rjes kyi cho ga rnams bdag 'jug ltar byas nas/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i brdar/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab bo// dbang bskur ba'i rim pa de dag dmigs pa rgya che bas ni phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyis len par bsgoms la/ 'bring gis phyi'i lha dgu dang*/ nang gi gtso bo lngas len zhing*/ chung bas ni phyi'i gtso bo 'ba' zhig gis blangs pa'i zhar la gzhan rnams kyis kyang thob par bsgom mo// maṇḍal dang*/ dbang rdzas yod na'ang legs/ med kyang btub bo// phyag len la ni ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad do// phyi'i dam tshig sems dpa' dpa' bo gcig pa tsam bsgom ste/ ye shes pa'i rkyen gyis lus kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gsal btab nas/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas 'bring gang yang rung ba rnams blangs kyang 'gal ba med do zhes bla ma dam pa rnams gsung ngo*// de ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ro// lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa len pa'i lag len/
dpon mo go go can gyis bskul nas 'phags pas shing pho khyi'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu bdun la sbyar te bskur ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
